incidentsResolved: GameSync standalone production pack used a nonexistent build:extension script; it now invokes the canonical npm run build and is regression-tested.
Android emulator CI compound shell syntax was split by the emulator action; the lane now runs one checked Bash script.
Android Settings could remain on the launcher with noReset; the fixture now forces the app into the foreground.
Appium session creation incorrectly inherited stepMs and could abort during UiAutomator2 startup; server readiness and session creation now use startupMs.
Opera GX vendor startup pages contaminated or stalled browser-matrix lifecycle; workload diagnostics are isolated and startup-page closing is bounded.
Windows browser-matrix execution could hang indefinitely on a leaked branded-browser runtime; each browser now runs in a killable worker process with explicit deadlines.
Browser trace/context teardown could hang; teardown is bounded and force-close fallback is evidence-visible.
Workbench desktop shutdown could deadlock on its own HTTP connection; server shutdown now closes idle/all connections and Electron shutdown is bounded.
Electron runtime handles could survive a completed run; Electron targets now execute inside killable worker processes.
Windows Workbench identity capture could race asynchronous dashboard startup; Ferrum now waits for the first real Electron window before querying main-process identity.

An unauthenticated private GitHub Wiki Git probe can return 404 for an existing wiki; Ferrum now uses available GitHub tokens and authenticated browser-root preflight so false 404s never automatically open or submit the first-page editor.
Process targets could launch interactive CLIs but could not drive stdin; Ferrum now supports bounded write-stdin and close-stdin process steps while preserving normal lifecycle evidence.
Evidence bundles lacked a cryptographic payload inventory; finalized bundles now write SHA-256 manifests and CLI/MCP verification detects tampering without dropping raw evidence.
MV3 popup text assertions could sample asynchronous content too early; assert-text now retries within one bounded deadline and reports the final observed text on failure.

A transient Appium find-all could return zero matches before Android UI convergence; constrained find-all now retries only within the existing step deadline, preserves the required threshold, and records final count plus attempt diagnostics.

STATUS monotonicity originally recognized only verifiedProduct evolution ledgers; checkpoint normalization now also recognizes improvement.product/improvement.mainRun so newer verified products cannot be hidden by schema drift.
